findings.finding: The original machine queue cloned into ActionGate but subsequent git commands relied on a parent cwd and could target the wrong directory.
findings.falsifier: Every repository command explicitly binds the cloned checkout with git -C or an atom-owned cwd.

findings.finding: The original LH-001 included git reset --hard even though bootstrap read-back requires no destructive branch mutation.
findings.falsifier: LH-001 uses a fresh clone plus detached switch to the immutable remote ref and grants no reset/rebase/sync/push/merge authority.

findings.finding: The human-readable queue assumed GNU sha256sum although the intended local lane includes macOS.
findings.falsifier: The queue no longer requires sha256sum; digest creation is delegated to Python or a host-native SHA-256 utility.

findings.finding: Machine and Markdown queue projections must describe the same authority ceiling and must not imply queue execution.
findings.falsifier: Both projections explicitly state that validation/readability is cloud/static evidence only and local/physical/Human lanes remain unexecuted.

findings.finding: The original scalar LH-002 next edge forced Android before iOS even though P8 defines the mobile physical lanes as independent siblings.
findings.falsifier: Queue v2 exposes next_candidates and an exactly-one-ACTIVE selection policy; the controller may choose any eligible sibling without inventing a false serial dependency.

findings.finding: The original argv array contained a literal $ACTIONGATE_IOS_DESTINATION token, which a direct process executor would not shell-expand.
findings.falsifier: Queue v2 uses explicit command templates and non-shell parameter bindings; the destination and scheme must be resolved before activation and passed as argv values.

remaining_dissent: LH-001 has not executed on a trusted local host.
Git Town executable/version/provenance is not admitted by this receipt.
Blocked Android/iOS command templates are not executable until A02/A03 freeze their exact task/scheme bindings.
Android and iOS physical lanes remain NOT_EXERCISED.
Merge, release, legal acceptance and production remain HUMAN_ADMIT_REQUIRED.
next_entry_condition: Execute LH-001 on the trusted personal clean-room host and bind its durable exact-subject receipt before activating LH-002.
